name: Smart Video Scheduler
intro: Smart Video Scheduler is an early content-calendar page. Today its Schedule tab opens Publish to Social, and timed scheduling and performance tracking are still to come.

features.calendar-tab: The Calendar tab is open when the page loads. It marks the spot where your scheduled posts will appear.
features.schedule-tab: The Schedule tab has a Publish to Social button. It opens the window where you add your video, create a thumbnail, write the copy and publish to a connected account right away.
features.analytics-tab: The Analytics tab previews the area where you'll track how your posts perform across platforms.

outro: That's the scheduler. Publish from the Schedule tab, and check back as timed scheduling grows.
